decision: Retain the DOS 6.0-identical drive parameter block layout.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
Selected BIOS and DOS sources include dpb.inc; DOS FAT and BUF use DPB sector size, FAT size, maximum cluster and other fields.
All 984 bytes of the previously compared FAT contribution match target MSDOS.SYS (review 065).
The 643-byte BUF comparison differs in only three marked external call displacements after alignment (review 044).
limitations: Prior comparisons support the DPB fields exercised in the selected modules, not all structure uses or final linking. Historical source identity and complete core binary equality remain unverified.
